description:
Workspace-wide propagation of the JMAP-h47t.24 fix from jmap-tasks-server to the canonical jmap-mail-server and the remaining 6 extension-server siblings.

Same pattern: every match on BackendSetError ends with an exhaustive-required catchall arm Err(_) => json!({"type": "serverFail", "description": "unhandled backend error variant"}). When a future variant is added to the #[non_exhaustive] enum, this catchall silently swallows the new variant's Display content and emits a meaningless placeholder string. Fix: bind the value and use its Display impl, matching the existing Other(e) arm shape — Err(other) => json!({"type": "serverFail", "description": other.to_string() }).

Sites still pending (87 total after tasks-server fix):

  jmap-mail-server   (28 sites): email.rs, mailbox.rs, sieve.rs, submission.rs,
                                 identity.rs, vacation.rs, mdn.rs
  jmap-chat-server   (15 sites): chat.rs, ban.rs, message.rs, space.rs, invite.rs,
                                 emoji.rs, presence.rs, contact.rs, position.rs
  jmap-calendars-server (12 sites): event.rs, calendar.rs, event_notification.rs,
                                 participant_identity.rs
  jmap-contacts-server (7 sites): card.rs, addressbook.rs
  jmap-filenode-server (6 sites): filenode.rs
  jmap-metadata-server (3 sites): metadata.rs
  jmap-sharing-server  (4 sites): principal.rs, notification.rs

Two sites in mail-server (calendars-server calendar.rs:433 and mail-server submission.rs:927) use a different containing shape — _ => CreateError::Server(...) or _ => String, not a json! literal. These are NOT in scope; their containing pattern is different and they need per-site judgement.

This sweep is mechanical: replace the seven-line Err(_) block with the two-line Err(other) block. cargo fmt + clippy + workspace test must remain green after each crate's pass.

Canonical-template order: change jmap-mail-server first (the canonical extension-server template), then propagate to the 6 siblings in one or several commits.
title: workspace canonical-template sweep: replace BackendSetError catchall placeholder string with other.to_string() across all *-server crates
